findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.citation_text:
6-301.12 Hand Drying Provision. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels.

The men’s bathroom in the facility is without paper towels by the hand sink at the time of this inspection. Paper towels were supplied during this inspection to correct.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.

A large hole is observed in the frame of the back door. This is remaining from the previous routine inspection conducted two years ago. Repairs the hole prior to the next routine inspection and maintain the facility in good repair moving forward.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.

The wall siding around the mop sink has been damaged and exposed wood/particle board. The PIC was shown and instructed to have repaired prior to the next routine inspection. Ensure that all areas subject to moisture are maintained sealed and smooth/easily cleanable.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.16 Drying Mops. After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air-dry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies. 

On arrival the mop is observed stored moist and with the head pooled up on the floor. The PIC was shown and instructed to store is so that the bristles are allowed to hang and air dry efficiently.
